company.name: Proven Skincare
company.shortDescription: Proven Skincare is a skincare company that provides users with scientific, clean, and specifically effective products.
company.description: Proven Skincare develops skincare products intended to allow customers to design and personalize products that fit their lifestyles. The company uses an artificial intelligence system that analyzes the skin conditions of customers, and allows for product customization down to the individual ingredient, enabling consumers to access a personalized skincare regiment that will work specifically for them.

productsAndServices.description: A personalized three-step skincare routine consisting of a cleanser, day moisturizer, and night cream formulated from an individual’s skin profile, environment, and lifestyle factors.
productsAndServices.name: PROVEN Personalized Skincare System

productsAndServices.description: A personalized skincare routine for acne that uses an individual’s skin, environmental, lifestyle, and hormonal information to select ingredients and concentrations for a cleanser, moisturizer, and night cream.
productsAndServices.name: PROVEN Personalized Acne Treatment

productsAndServices.description: A customized day moisturizer formulated to address an individual’s dark spots and support protection against new discoloration, with ingredients and concentrations selected from a personal skin profile.
productsAndServices.name: PROVEN Personalized Dark-Spot Moisturizer

productsAndServices.description: An online skin assessment and formulation service that maps customer responses to a skincare database to determine personalized ingredient selections and concentrations.
productsAndServices.name: PROVEN Skin Analysis and AI Formulation Service

productsAndServices.description: A recurring skincare service that delivers personalized formulas on a selected schedule and supports formula adjustments when a customer’s skin, environment, or results change.
productsAndServices.name: PROVEN Adaptive Subscription and Reformulation Service
